_comment: Source of truth for Cy data handling. Update this whenever collection, storage, transmission, retention, or deletion changes. Policy wording requires human approval before release.
collects: Postcard text, an optional chosen handle, and an optional uploaded or Openverse-selected image voluntarily submitted by a visitor
A random visitor identifier in a signed HttpOnly cookie, used to recognise a returning postcard writer
IP addresses on postcard and rate-limit records for abuse prevention
Short-lived viewer-presence observations derived from event-stream polling
Owner-selected runner controls including tempo, day or night regime, pause state, and model provider
stores: The ordered public event stream, including screened Cy prose, prison events, public postcard fields, drawings, operational telemetry, and sourced Soma circuit snapshots
Queued and delivered postcards, their delivery schedule, submitted text, optional handle, moderation state, and rate-limit metadata
Uploaded or remotely selected postcard images re-encoded as WebP with metadata removed, plus source attribution when applicable
A returning visitor's postcard count, compact rolling notes, and legacy synthetic standing values

On the Dell runner, a bounded Soma episodic memory of up to 512 selected environmental events. An episode may contain postcard text or caption, a prison incident, a warden notice, or machine-continuity evidence, together with time, category, tags, and computed salience
On the Dell runner, learned event-family expectations, current attention and action, self-model evidence, and other implemented Soma state in the gitignored runtime state file
On the Dell runner, a rolling context of screened Cy-generated prose, operational logs, electricity and paid-provider spend totals, and retry queues

transmits.purpose: Deliver due mail and real environment state to Cy and maintain the continuous process
transmits.data: Due postcard text and image reference, chosen handle, returning-visitor memory and standing, warden notices, news, tempo, and owner controls

transmits.purpose: Publish the screened experience and maintain queued visitor interactions
transmits.data: Batched public events and private visitor or drawing write-backs from the Dell runner

transmits.recipient: DeepSeek, only while the owner has selected the optional remote provider
transmits.purpose: Generate Cy's prose or drawing instructions
transmits.data: The current prompt, which can include recent screened Cy prose, selected Soma attention and action, recent incidents, incoming postcard text, and compact returning-visitor context

transmits.recipient: Openverse and the host of a selected public image
transmits.purpose: Search for a visitor-requested postcard image and fetch the selected public image
transmits.data: The visitor's image-search query is sent to Openverse; the selected image URL is then requested from its host

transmits.purpose: Render and replay the live or historical Cy experience
transmits.data: Screened public event-stream content, public postcard fields, drawings, operational telemetry, implemented Soma snapshots, and clearly labelled legacy placeholder values

does_not_store: Raw uploaded image metadata after re-encoding
Model-provider API keys in the repository or public event stream
Blocked postcard text or blocked model output in the public event stream
A biological or clinical measurement of Cy; brain locations and legacy vitals are explicit analogies or placeholders
notes: Generated model text is not fed back into implemented Soma state. It is retained only as screened narrative context and public output.
Soma memory is bounded by count and preferentially retains salient older episodes alongside recent ones; a time-based deletion period is not currently implemented.
Policy wording generated from this manifest requires human review before release.
